question: how much is done by the AI, how much by docair?
title: What the model does, and what docair does around it
summary: docair builds the graph, the page and the edits itself; the model is consulted in four places, and each time docair prepares the input and checks the output against the graph.

steps.title: docair builds the graph itself, no model involved
steps.text: Scanning is deterministic: docair walks the files, extracts doc blocks, lets the language adapters read the code, and resolves refs into edges. The model is never asked during a scan — the graph is docair's own work.

steps.title: Your question goes to the model with a digest docair made
steps.text: When you ask something, docair condenses the graph into a digest — nodes, edges and scenarios, no source code — and sends it with the question and the earlier turns. The prompt is docair's; the answer is the model's.

steps.title: docair checks the model's reply against the graph
steps.text: The model answers with a walkthrough in JSON, but docair binds every id and proposed edit against the graph and sends one repair request when the reply names things that are not there. Only a reply that fits the graph is kept.

steps.title: docair, not the model, writes the files
steps.text: The checked reply becomes a recorded walkthrough and a patch of doc blocks, written by docair's edit code. The model proposes; docair resolves where each edit goes and applies it.

steps.title: Three smaller AI jobs, each wrapped by docair
steps.text: The model also words the lines that say nothing (docair word), proposes glossary entries (docair glossary), and reviews what two commits change (docair explain). In each, docair prepares the input — the unworded lines, the docs' words, the pieces and intent of a change — and keeps only what binds to the graph.

steps.title: Everything else is docair's own code
steps.text: Layout, the SVG pictures, the self-contained page, the server, tidy, slices and the changes between commits are all deterministic docair code. The model appears nowhere in them.
